findings.what: poster and carousel end UNIMPROVABLE with a remaining WARN:text-overflow on element 'subhead'. Diagnosis: the safe-zone WARN (20px inside the safe area) can only be addressed by the shrink branch, which clamps at size 10px; the edge-spill 'pull to safe area' branch moves a different element (the canvas-edge spill), so no branch moves subhead upward. Round 3 records the fix message «داخل الصندوق — حجم 10px» while changing nothing, then honestly reports UNIMPROVABLE.
findings.impact: 2 of 3 baseline briefs do not reach CLEAN; a 10px subhead sits near the canvas edge.
findings.action: recorded as baseline truth; not 'fixed' silently — any change must be deliberate and re-tested
